subtopic: Form CRS and Form ADV Fee Disclosures
source_evidence: Form CRS (also called the client relationship summary or Form ADV Part 3) will give you a summary of the fees an adviser charges and the services it offers.
question: Misconception: Form CRS provides all the detailed information about an adviser’s fees and services, so there is no reason to consult Form ADV Part 2A.
answer: Correction: Form CRS provides a summary of fees and services. For additional generalized information, the source says to read the adviser’s responses to Item 4 and Item 5 in Form ADV Part 2A, also called the adviser’s brochure.
